payload.core_mechanism_summary: Factorize n into prime powers. For each prime exponent e, use matrix exponentiation on a (e+1)×(e+1) upper triangular transition matrix to compute the distribution after k steps, then compute expected power contribution and multiply across primes.
payload.rationale: State is the exponent (1D), so dp_1d_state is most descriptive despite using a 2D matrix for transitions.
